rules.title: Schema as source
rules.text: Change the database only through the schema file and generated migrations.

rules.title: Select only needed fields
rules.text: Select only the fields you need and avoid returning full rows to the client.

rules.title: Use transactions
rules.text: Wrap related writes in a transaction.

rules.title: Single client instance
rules.text: Create one database client per process and reuse it.

rules.title: Parameterize raw SQL
rules.text: When using raw SQL, always use parameterized queries.
